description: This file defines the TaskDao interface which provides CRUD database operations for Task entities in an Android project using Room persistence library.

classes.name: TaskDao
classes.description: A data access object interface for performing CRUD operations on Task entities within the Room database.

methods.name: observeAll
methods.description: Returns a LiveData list of all Task entities, ordered by completion status, due date presence, due date, and last update time.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves a Task by its unique ID asynchronously; returns null if not found.

methods.name: insert
methods.description: Inserts a new Task into the database with conflict resolution to replace existing entries. Returns the row ID of the inserted Task.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing Task in the database asynchronously. Returns the number of rows affected.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a specified Task from the database asynchronously. Returns the number of rows affected.

methods.name: deleteAll
methods.description: Deletes all Task entries from the database asynchronously.
